deployment_note: Built, validated, fixture-tested. INACTIVE/unpublished by design — webhook endpoint is not live until the founder explicitly publishes. Test/manual executions work while inactive.

nodes.name: Stage-2 Search Request
nodes.role: runtime input (tenant_id, product_id, market, search_query, request_id, persist)

nodes.name: Validate Input
nodes.role: fail-closed validation: uuid tenant_id+product_id, non-empty market+search_query; normalize market upper, persist default false

nodes.name: Assert Owned
nodes.role: fail closed (STAGE2_TENANT_PRODUCT_NOT_OWNED) unless returned id == product_id; before any CJ call

nodes.name: CJ Search
nodes.role: CJ product/list with RUNTIME productNameEn = search_query (no hardcoded query); single call per invocation

nodes.name: Build Candidates
nodes.role: normalize to Stage-2 candidate shape + build resolver rpc_body (does NOT judge matches)

nodes.name: Resolve Identity
nodes.role: POST rpc/fn_resolve_concrete_supplier_identity (EXISTING resolver, unchanged); p_persist from input

nodes.name: Build Response
nodes.role: envelope: echo request_id, candidate_count, resolver verdict, bound

decision_contract.persistence: p_persist=false => evaluate only (no bind); p_persist=true => upsert on (tenant, product, market), bind only on EXACT
